answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 315 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the gale. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the delta queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. The basalt index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 402 account operation therefore ties up 33 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
